'''Mikheil Ukleba''' (Georgian: მიხეილ უკლება]; born April 15, 1953{{cn|date=December 2024}}) is a Georgian diplomat and politician. 

He was the Minister of State Property of Georgia (1998–2001), until he transitioned to Ambassador-at-Large and became the Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of Georgia to the People's Republic of China (2004–2008), Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of Georgia to Bulgaria (2008–2008), Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of Georgia to Ukraine (2013–2017).

== Biography ==

=== 1990s ===
Ukleba entered the Georgian government in 1989. He served as a Senior Economist, Head of the Department of Foreign Affairs, and First Deputy Head of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Georgia.<ref>{{Cite book|chapter-url=https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-981-13-9159-0_3|title=Recently Acceded Members of the World Trade Organization: Membership, the Doha Development Agenda, and Dispute Settlement|first=Kenji|last=Takamiya|chapter=Georgia |editor-first=Kenji|editor-last=Takamiya|date=December 26, 2019|publisher=Springer|pages=93–136|via=Springer Link|doi=10.1007/978-981-13-9159-0_3|isbn=978-981-13-9159-0 }}</ref>

In 1998, Ukleba became the Minister of State Property of Georgia.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.rferl.org/a/1141715.html|title=Newsline - August 10, 1998|work=Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty |date=June 20, 2008|via=www.rferl.org}}</ref>

=== 2000s ===
In 2005, Ukleba was appointed [[List of ambassadors of Georgia to China|Georgia's first Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary to the People's Republic of China]].{{cn|date=December 2024}}

In 2008, Ukleba was appointed as the Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of Georgia to Bulgaria. He was awarded the [[Order of the Stara Planina]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mfa.bg/embassies/ukraine/news/7173|title=Орден "Стара планина"- I степен за бившия посланик на Грузия в България Н.Пр.Михаил Уклеба|website=www.mfa.bg}}</ref>

=== 2010s ===
In 2013, Ukleba served as Georgia's Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary to Ukraine, serving until 2017. The period was marked by significant political and social upheaval during the [[Revolution of Dignity]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mfa.gov.ua/en/news/17618-zastupnik-ministra-zakordonnih-sprav-ukrajini-viktor-majko-prijnyav-nadzvichajnogo-i-povnovazhnogo-posla-gruziji-v-ukrajini-mihejila-uklebu|title=Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ukraine - Deputy Minister for Foreign Affairs of Ukraine Victor Mayko received Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of Georgia to Ukraine Mikheil Ukleba|website=mfa.gov.ua}}</ref>

Since 2018, Ukleba has been serving at the Diplomatic Institute.
